```plaintext
Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating __the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium consisting essentially of water__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

Claim 2 (Cancelled)

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated.

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises heating __the shed cellular material__ and agitation.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme, __preferably a cell wall degrading enzyme__.

Claim 8 (Original)

Claim 9 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA.

Claim 10 (Original)

Claim 11 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more __immature embryos as defined by their developmental stage__.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos in a __quiescent condition__ prior to step (c) or (d).

Claim 13 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __selected from the group consisting of genotyping__.

Claim 14 (Original)

Claim 15 (Cancelled)

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is __optionally__ performed.

Claim 17 (Cancelled)

Claim 18 (Cancelled)

Claim 19 (Cancelled)
```
